chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:

I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who goes out to his estate and stays for one day, two days, or three: should he shorten or complete? He said: He completes the salat (prayer) whenever he comes to an estate among his estates.
The explanation regarding this report is the same as what we have already presented concerning the earlier reports.
ai.seo_question: Does a person complete or shorten salat (prayer) when traveling to his own estate?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person traveling to his own estate and staying there briefly. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that he should perform the salat (prayer) in full when he comes to one of his estates, and the compiler notes that its interpretation is the same as earlier reports on the subject.
